summary: CapSense on the QWA309 PSoC 4000T (EZI2C @0x08) read from CM55, which owns SCB5 in display/LVGL apps (as in the TESAIoT SDK) - same driver as qwa309-capsense
hw_settings: QWA309 CS select switch = ON (powers/connects the CapSense PSoC 4000T side of SCB5; if CS ON holds SCB5 low on your board, CapSense cannot be used - see hw-troubleshooting)
source: copy of qwa309-capsense (core-neutral source: keep proj_cm33_ns and proj_cm55 copies of this component's files identical)
notes: SCB5 is claimed by i2c-scb5-cm55 (display touch + panel MCU on the same bus, same core, no lock needed). Hardware state of the 4000T varies per board - see the tesaiot board sheet
